title: markdown-indexer article
description: The published per-document JSON at /articles/$UUID.json: identity, path, front matter CID, and markdown body, without the inlined front matter object.

uuid.description: The document's UUID. It is also the file name.

relativePath.description: Path relative to the vault root, always with forward slashes.

modifiedUnix.description: Last modified, as a unix timestamp in seconds.

frontmatter_cid.description: CIDv1 (dag-json codec, sha2-256) of the front matter. Join to /frontmatter/$frontmatter_cid.json.

raw_markdown.description: The markdown body. A publisher may rewrite asset links in this field; raw_markdown_hash remains the vault body's hash.

raw_markdown_hash.description: Hex sha256 of the vault body, even when raw_markdown has been rewritten.
